title: Marks on the Page
label: ch:ka-viraama-chihne
canDo: I can name the punctuation marks a Kannada page uses, write the three a sentence of my own needs, and recognise the rest when a notice or a form puts them in front of me.

payoff.summary: From cold: name the three marks you write yourself, say where a question mark goes and how many a question gets, and name every mark in the previous chapter's reading passage.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three, with nothing open in front of the reader.
